feature: Event maximumExecutionCount=3 with a level trigger
description: Event (count 3, trigger SimulationTime >= 1, edge none) sets 22 m/s with a step SpeedAction; executions are counted from the lifecycle log.

oracle.derivation: Each execution completes instantly (step) and returns to standby while executions < 3 (8.4.2.1); the level condition is still true, so the event restarts on a later check and stops after exactly 3 startTransitions. Speed is 22 m/s from t=1.
